sources.snippet: This is distinct from the post-training-quantized LFM2.5-2.6B-Q4_0.gguf; both use the GGUF Q4_0 format. QAD source weights (safetensors) The original FP32 QAD source checkpoint is available in qad/, with its model config, tokenizer, generation defaults, and the same chat template as the released QAD GGUF.

sources.title: LFM2.5-2.6B-GGUF · Models - modelscope.cn
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-2.6B-GGUF LFM2.5-2.6B is Liquid AI's agent-focused member of the LFM2.5 hybrid model family, a 2.69-billion-parameter, text-only model built on the LFM2 architecture with a 128K-token context window and post-trained specifically for agentic workloads.
